basis: Codex review #8 step 7: ECR Basic scanning covers OS packages only; a Python-aware audit was required. Performed via OSV querybatch over the image venv's pip freeze (93 packages) - evidence B5-PYAUDIT-FT21B-2026-001.json.
rationale: the trainer runs in a private VPC subnet with no inbound surface, VPC endpoints only, and processes exclusively owned S3 data under the job role
torch advisories centre on deserialization/DoS of UNTRUSTED inputs; the loop torch.loads only self-written checkpoints whose bytes are hash-bound (marker -> model -> sidecar chain)
setuptools advisories concern package-installation paths; the runtime image has no pip and installs nothing at runtime
the image is never a serving surface (ARCH-2026-001 sequencing keeps serving images separate)
conditions: pins are bumped at the next scheduled image refresh; any bump re-runs the full qualification chain (in-image tests + calibration)
this acceptance does NOT transfer to any serving image - serving images get their own Python-aware audit at the serving-contract step
re-audit on every new trainer image push (freeze + OSV batch, ~1 minute)
